summary: The implementation adds a comprehensive result page with resume data display, scoring breakdown, skill gap analysis, recommendations, and comparison features. However, several key requirements around inline editing, PDF download, and full certification display are missing or incomplete. The page uses the correct color scheme and includes proper routing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement inline editing functionality on the result page allowing users to modify extracted resume data fields (contact info, work experience, education, skills) with save functionality that updates the backend resume record
missing_requirements.reason: While ComprehensiveResultPage.tsx shows editing state management (isEditing, editedData, setEditedData), the actual edit UI components, input fields for modifying data, validation logic, and save button implementation are not visible in the truncated code. The backend has updateResumeData mutation hook, but no evidence of form fields or edit buttons in the UI.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a download report button on the result page that generates and downloads a comprehensive PDF report
missing_requirements.reason: While ComprehensiveResultPage.tsx has isDownloading state and imports generateAnalysisReport from pdfGenerator service, the actual download button implementation and PDF generation logic are not visible in the truncated code. No evidence of the download button UI or click handler.

missing_requirements.requirement: Display certifications with issuing organization and dates
missing_requirements.reason: The resumeData structure maps certifications to resume.recommendations without organization or date information. No certification-specific display component is visible in the diff showing issuing organization and dates as required by acceptance criteria.
